ui_rules: Keep agents/openai.yaml limited to Skill discovery metadata and a concise default prompt.
Do not introduce theme, locale, or visual prototype work.
database_entities: None; package and generated project state remain local files.
permissions: Read one explicitly selected Markdown file and confined referenced local resources.
Write one explicitly selected non-existing destination and bounded sibling staging directory.
Install only after an explicit installer command into a resolved Codex Skill destination.
Execute only the explicitly resolved local docforge command.
Treat the installed Yao engine as read-only and never authorize --self.
No network, AI credential, Office automation, privilege elevation, or npm lifecycle installation.
data_flows: Markdown and local resources -> import plan -> staged DocForge project -> inspect -> validate -> atomic destination.
npm package -> explicit installer -> staged Skill -> validation -> atomic Codex Skill destination.
Optional verification -> docforge build -> manifest-resolved build/document.docx.
